title: The Yoast SEO WordPress plugin before 28.9 does not check that content is publicly viewable before returning its SEO…
description: A vulnerability in the Yoast SEO WordPress plugin versions before 28.9 allows unauthenticated users to access SEO metadata of private content via a public REST endpoint. This metadata includes the title, author, publication date, and an excerpt of private posts, pages, or custom post types if the URL is known or guessed.
